html:
G'oya

Har bir son oldingi ikkitasidan yasaladi, rekursiv qism esa faqat bitta oldingi qatorni ko'radi. Shuning uchun qatorda ikki sonni birga olib yuramiz: joriy fib va undan keyingi next_fib. Har qadamda juftlik bir pog'ona suriladi: (fib, next_fib) dan (next_fib, fib + next_fib) hosil bo'ladi.

Yechim

WITH RECURSIVE f(k, fib, next_fib) AS (
  SELECT 1, 1, 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT k + 1, next_fib, fib + next_fib FROM f WHERE k < 40
)
SELECT k, fib
FROM f
WHERE k <= (SELECT n FROM params)

n 40 dan oshmaydi, shuning uchun rekursiya doim 40 ta sonni yasaydi, keraklisini tashqi WHERE kesib oladi. n = 0 da birorta k ham shartdan o'tmaydi va natija bo'sh. Eng katta oraliq qiymat, 41-son 165 580 141, oddiy INTEGER ga ham sig'adi.

Tuzoqlar

Ketma-ketlikni 0 dan boshlash. Ba'zi kitoblarda Fibonachchi 0, 1, 1, 2 deb yoziladi, lekin bu masalada birinchi son 1. Boshlang'ich qatorda 0 bo'lsa, hamma son bir o'ringa siljiydi:

Noto'g'riWITH RECURSIVE f(k, fib, next_fib) AS (
  SELECT 1, 0, 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT k + 1, next_fib, fib + next_fib FROM f WHERE k < 40
)
SELECT k, fib
FROM f
WHERE k <= (SELECT n FROM params)

Teskari xato ham uchraydi: SELECT 1, 1, 2. Unda ikkinchi son 1 emas, 2 bo'lib qoladi.

Boshqa yo'l

Rekursiyani aynan n da to'xtatish ham mumkin. Boshlang'ich qismdagi WHERE n >= 1 n = 0 holatini to'sadi, params da bitta qator bo'lgani uchun vergul bilan ulash qatorlarni ko'paytirmaydi:

WITH RECURSIVE f(k, a, b) AS (
  SELECT 1, 1, 1 FROM params WHERE n >= 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT k + 1, b, a + b FROM f, params WHERE k < n
)
SELECT k, a AS fib FROM f
